youtube_description:
FULL MAIN SLAM AT: 7:55
In our latest video, "What Is The Most Famous Slam Ever?" we asked a handful of top tier Professional Skateboarders what they think the "most famous” skateboarding fail ever is.  That doesn't mean the worst, gnarliest, hardest, softest, loudest, coolest, lamest or funniest…but the most viewed.  We interviewed Ryan Sheckler, Paul Rodriguez, Nyah Huston, Sean Malto, Jamie Thomas, Geoff Rowley, Chris Cole, Chris Joslin, Jeremy Wray, Mark Appleyard, Stefan Janoski, Torey Pudwill, Bucky Lasek, Colin Mckay, Pat Duffy, Aaron "JAWS" Homoki and the infamous Matt Schlager.  It was a very close call but when it came down to it, we determined Matt Schlager's to be the "most famous" given that it went viral not only on the internet but National TV as well; being featured on well-known shows such as Rob Dyrdek's MTV show "Ridiculous" as well as MTV "Scarred".  Not only that, he even got his own Baker Skateboards guest model.  So what do you think?  Did we get it right?  Did we miss any?  Comment and Subscribe!

Jake Brown - X Games
Jamie Foy - Thrasher "Hall of Meat"
